options.text: Change only the hours of sunlight; keep the water volume and pot size the same in both trays.
Keep the hours of sunlight the same; change the water volume and the pot size together.
Change the hours of sunlight and the water volume together; keep only the pot size the same.
A fair sunlight test must use the same hours of sunlight, the same water volume, and the same pot size in both trays.

stem:
Aditya wants to find out whether hours of sunlight affect how tall mustard seedlings grow.

He can change hours of sunlight, water volume, and pot size.

Which plan is a fair test of sunlight?

teacher.key_rationale: A fair test of sunlight changes only hours of sunlight and keeps water volume and pot size the same.
